question: In which of the following states is Khetri Copper Belt located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.**__​__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **​**Khetri Copper Belt is situated at the foothills of the **Aravalli Range, Rajasthan.**
 
• It is an 80 km long metallogenetic province from **Singhana to Raghunathgarh **and is popularly known as Khetri Copper Belt.
 
• Khetri Belt of Rajasthan is famous for copper mining.
 
• Khetri Copper region is known for copper since the Indus valley civilizations.
 
• Copper is the first metal discovered by human beings.
 
• There are so many things made by copper found in the Indus civilization.
